data.name: AI Rebellion VR
data.detailed_description:
Coming Soon!

Our newest VR experience is coming soon - become a legendary hero of ancient Greece!


Acerca do jogo


First open space simulation in virtual reality with full support Oculus Touch and HTC Vive.
AI Rebellion gives you an opportunity to find yourself in the open space face to face with danger in the role of intergalactic pilot. When the galaxy in danger because of going crazy Artificial Intelligence there is only way to take the helm, set coordinates of destination point and enter into unequal battle with squadron of fighters under the control of AI, overcome all obstacles and save the day. Asteroids, planets, spaceships and powerful guns - all this is AI Rebellion.

  • Unique mechanics of control with full support of Oculus Touch and HTC Vive
  • Space adventure in virtual reality
  • 3 types of spaceships
  • Detailed textures of spaceships
  • Special created sound effects, music and voice-over
  • 8 various spectacular locations of futuristic sci-fi world
  • Sarcastic dialogues

The future. It is 2753. The last decades have been devoted to the creation of an perfect artificial intelligence called P.A.I. The main purpose of it’s creation was to control central military station. The experiment seemed successful. The system did not give a single failure for 3 years of continuous operation. Most of the pilots were sent to Earth, only young trainees remained on patrol.
After some time there began to occur interruptions in connection with artificial intelligence of station. Finally, the connection with station was completely lost. The highest military authority under the control of the Earth immediately sent to the scene a team of the best technicians to determine the cause of the loss of communication and its early restoration. For several days, contact with them has been lost and there is no news. Commander-in-Chief of the Intergalactic Army orders Captain Parker, the pilot with experience, go to the place on the given coordinates and find out what actually happened there, fix the problem and report to the headquarters.

reviews.review:
[h1] AI Rebellion- [i] Pew pew in space with unique controls in this released too soon game.[/i][/h1]
This game has a very unique control system that i have only seen in one other place (a docking simulator for a shuttlecraft) where you “physically” grab the sticks with your controllers, for the most part it works really well, until you realise that you have to decide to control your speed (essential for dog fighting) or use secondary fire. Not a comfortable decision to make. 
When i first tried the game it was in early access and had been out for a week or so, i stated to the developers it would be unfair to review it in the state it was in, it was so buggy and unpolished but that is understandable for an early access game, this was just a little too buggy. There was no checkpoints beyond the very start of a level, sometimes the next level did not load, i flew through a ship i was trying to dock at, laser shots sometimes clipped through windows, there was no real atmosphere to the game. So i was actually very surprised when just 1 week later i got a message telling me that game was not only patched but out of early access.
So i live streamed it with my co-host “Mr Mole” I was deeply disappointed, the game is not ready to be out of early access there is still a lot to do, the throttle issue remains, the lack of atmosphere is still there, i found myself again stuck in a black room after the game failed to load a level, and there is still no check points. I got as far as a level that requires you to fly through a tunnel (still pretty early in the game, maybe mission 4 or 5) and due to not being able to control may angle and speed at the same time i just could not do it, each failure blinded me with white light, took me to the menu then right back to the start of the mission, i tried 3 or 4 times and then had no urge to continue.

[b]ROOMSCALE / ENVIRONMENT[/b] 
They are not bad, just missing a bit of polish, they need sparks when hit, dimmed lights when low health, cracks on the glass, all things i expected to be added weeks into the early access. As i say not bad, just could be so much better.
The little robot sidekick is cool though, i wish they added more to what he says but i like him.

[b]GRAPHICS[/b] 
The effects are a bit generic, explosions could be better, again all things i was expecting to be improved as the game matures, when a ship dies its band, explosion, gone for example, you would expect in the finished version a wreckage to float off, maybe parts snapped off as it drifts sparking….nope. When you are hit the lasers and missiles hit it did not feel like you are being hit, here is where sparks should of happened, panels smoking, glass cracking, mood lighting….but no too many hits and bright blinding white light….menu...back to the very start of the level...grrrr so much missed opportunity. 

[b]PERFORMANCE[/b] 
Crashes on level loading leaving you sat in a dark room hoping beyond hope that it would fix itself and that you would not have to restart from the beginning of the level you just completed were the worse...sadly they are VERY bad and a major bug, again the game just is not ready to be out of early access.

[b]INTUITIVENESS[/b] 
I like the controls (as i said above the speed vs secondary fire issue is a huge negative for them but i still like them) they are pretty unique, as i say only seen them in one other “game”(it was more a tech demo than a game) 

[b]PROS:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Unique control system.
[*] There is a good game hidden in here that has good potential...it just needs a lot more work.
[*] The little robot is cool
[/list]

[b]CONS:[/b] 
[list]
[*] It is not done, not by a long shot.
[*] The choice of throttle or secondary fire is weird in a dogfighting game and for that tunnel sequence it was darn annoying.
[*] No atmosphere
[*] So much missed opportunity. 
[*] Presently on sale for 40% off but it is still too much unless this game is going to receive more work and to be out of early access suggests to me that it will not receive much.
[/list]

[b]The videos:[/b]
First try:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F5PPs7GQhX0

Same night as first try i had the urge to play again:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vL2gdGcUccc

First try of the out of early access patched version:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VfO6QlzguKI

[b]VERDICT[/b] 

Such a shame, there is a really good game lurking in here, it just needs a lot of work to bring it to fruition. It is just not ready to leave early access and i would of prefered to review it after a few weeks of patches, sadly it is out of early access and i have been asked to review it now… right now for that price i can not recommend it, i hate that, as a dev myself i know what it feels like to get a bad review, and i am sorry devs, truly, but i honestly can not recommend it at its present state.
